description: Formal IMDB 10-seed training and validation-selected test evaluation for five parameter-matched models.
notes: Fixed validation-best hyperparameters from the completed seed42 imdb_5model_full50_grid; that completed full-budget grid is the readiness evidence, so no separate training smoke was added.
Each unit trains all 50 epochs with patience=999999 and evaluates the test split once from its validation-best checkpoint.
Mamba and S5 are intentionally excluded by user request.
Processed IMDB data was absent at submission; CPU preflight 61717068 prepares and validates the deterministic seed42, vocab25000, max_len400 dataset before afterok releases the GPU array.
Initial pending jobs 61717049 and 61717050 were canceled before execution after post-submit verification found an incorrect repository root. No result directory was created by that attempt.
